channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Charleston County Public Works officials to share update on Sol Legare Road pedestrian safety improvements
item.description: Charleston County Public Works officials will host a community meeting to share updates on the Sol Legare Road Sidewalk Project, a pedestrian safety initiative aimed at creating a safer, more accessible walking corridor along Sol Legare Road

item.title: Lord Huron to Play Credit One Stadium on June 16
item.description: Indie folk band Lord Huron will perform at Credit One Stadium on Tuesday, June 16, 2026 at 7:30 p.m. Tickets go on sale Friday, Jan. 23 at 10 a.m.

item.title: Charleston County Economic Development honors industry leaders, launches 2026 “Year of Defense” initiative
item.description: Charleston County Economic Development (CCED) brought together business leaders, elected officials, and community partners on Tuesday, January 13, for its annual Industry Appreciation Luncheon

item.title: Maynard Nexsen Adds Experienced Patent Attorney to IP Team
item.description: Maynard Nexsen, a full-service law firm with 31 offices nationwide, welcomes Doug Lineberry to its Greenville, SC, location.

item.title: RiverDogs announce 2026 Coaching Staff
item.description: The Charleston RiverDogs, in conjunction with the Tampa Bay Rays, have announced their coaching staff for the 2026 season.

item.title: Gov. McMaster Declares State of Emergency Ahead of Winter Storm
item.description: Governor Henry McMaster today issued Executive Order 2026-02 declaring a State of Emergency in preparation for a winter storm system expected to impact the state beginning Saturday and continuing through the weekend, possibly into Monday.

item.title: Rockabillaque Charleston Cancels 2026 Event
item.description: Rockabillaque, the South’s largest festival celebrating midcentury Americana culture, announced that it will not be held in Charleston this year. The event had planned to celebrate its 13th anniversary this fall in Park Circle.

item.title: Quintin’s Close-Ups: Southeastern Wildlife Expo's John Powell
item.description: Quintin Washington of Quintin's Close-Ups recently spoke with a Charleston news maker. You can watch the interview below.

item.title: Charleston’s Gluten-Free Brunch Standout: Slightly North of Broad
item.description: Gluten-free brunch lovers, rejoice—Slightly North of Broad (SNOB) is quietly serving one of the best (and rarest) gluten-free brunch menus in Charleston.

item.title: CF Evans Construction Selected to Build Album Dorchester, 55+ Community in North Charleston
item.description: CF Evans Construction, one of the Southeast’s leading multifamily general contractors, has been selected by Buvermo as the general contractor for Album Dorchester, a new 55-plus active-adult community located in North Charleston
